question.text: The Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides health coverage of up to:

answer.text: Rs.2 lakh per family per year
Rs.5 lakh per family per year
Rs.10 lakh per family per year
Rs.3 lakh per family per year

explanation.text: The Logic: The Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides health insurance cover of up to Rs.5 lakh per family per year on a family-floater basis, for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation, to eligible beneficiary families identified on the basis of socio-economic and deprivation criteria. The scheme is delivered through empanelled public and private hospitals on a cashless basis. The Trap: Rs.2 lakh per family per year corresponds approximately to the cover under the earlier Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) framework, which PM-JAY largely superseded. Rs.3 lakh is a plausible-sounding intermediate figure that does not correspond to the scheme. Rs.10 lakh is a typical private-sector family-floater sum insured, but PM-JAY's headline limit is set at Rs.5 lakh per family per year. Note: The cited NISM Series XVII Retirement Adviser workbook pages discuss schemes such as APY and PMVVY and broader retirement-adequacy themes but do not contain the PM-JAY Rs.5 lakh coverage statement. The Rs.5 lakh figure used above is presented as general knowledge of the publicly announced PM-JAY scheme parameters, not as a workbook-page citation.
